_note: The Base screen renders THIS LIST, not hardcoded buttons — v1+ adds tannery, apothecary, tavern and they should be a JSON edit plus a route. 'route' must match a case of AppRoute. TIER SEMANTICS: tier counts UPGRADES PURCHASED, so tier 0 = built and un-upgraded. Essence Spring 0 = the built-in trickle, 1 = the purchasable upgrade. A station with 'builtBy' is NOT bought — you find that person out in a world (their signature is in travellers.json), talk them into coming home, and THEN raise the building for 'buildCost'. BUILD COST LADDER (Aimee, 6 Aug): the more advanced the trade, the more it takes. Early ~30 essence + ~18 raw (the Blacksmith, deliberately reachable on an early haul); middling ~80 + ~60 and wants an uncommon resource; late ~200 + ~150 and wants something you can only get out of a world too greedy to be stable. A late building should be several hauls of setup, not one. All PLACEHOLDER.
